title: Geometric irreducibility passes to subextensions
statement: Let $k\subseteq L\subseteq K$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension]. If $K/k$ is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], then $L/k$ is geometrically irreducible.
